Optimal_Description: Subject bends the knees to descend the body toward the floor with the heels on the floor the knees aligned over the feet the upper body remains aligned in the vertical plane
Non_Optimal_Description: Subject does not maintain upright trunk posture unable to squat past parallel demonstrates knee valgus collapse or trunk flexion greater than 30 degrees

Optimal_Description: Subject steps over the hurdle while the hips knees and ankles of the standing leg remain vertical
Non_Optimal_Description: Subject does not maintain upright trunk posture has less than 89 degrees hip flexion does not maintain femur in neutral position

Optimal_Description: Subject takes a step forward and lowers the body toward the floor to make contact with the knee behind the front foot
Non_Optimal_Description: Subject unable to maintain upright trunk posture has rear knee reach the floor or has a lateral deviation in forward step

Optimal_Description: Subject takes a step to the side and lowers the body toward the floor
Non_Optimal_Description: Subject displays moderate to significant knee valgus collapse pelvis drops or rises more than 5 degrees trunk angle of less than 30 degrees thigh angle of more than 45 degrees center of knee is anterior to the toes

Optimal_Description: Subject lifts the body from a chair to a standing position
Non_Optimal_Description: Subject unable to maintain upright trunk posture pelvis rises 5 degrees or more uses arms or compensatory motion to stand unable to maintain balance or shifts weight to one leg displays moderate to significant knee valgus collapse

Optimal_Description: Subject raises one leg in front of the body while keeping the leg straight and the body vertical
Non_Optimal_Description: Subject unable to maintain upright trunk posture pelvis deviates 5 degrees or more more than 6 degrees of knee flexion and less than 59 degrees of hip flexion

Optimal_Description: Subject raises one arm to the side by a lateral rotation keeping the elbow and wrist straight
Non_Optimal_Description: Subject unable to maintain upright trunk posture or head in neutral position lift arm does not remain in plane of motion less than 160 degrees of abduction

Optimal_Description: Subject extends one arm rearward keeping the elbow and wrist straight
Non_Optimal_Description: Subject unable to maintain upright trunk posture or head in neutral position lift arm does not remain in sagittal plane less than 45 degrees of extension

Optimal_Description: Subject bends one elbow to a 90 degree angle and rotates the forearm forward and backward
Non_Optimal_Description: Subject unable to maintain upright trunk posture or head in neutral position arm positioning less than 60 degrees of motion in both directions

Optimal_Description: Subject raises one arm in front of the chest until reaching the shoulders height keeping the elbow and wrist straight
Non_Optimal_Description: Subject unable to maintain upright trunk posture or head in neutral position arm lift is not maintained in correct plane less than 90 degrees of motion
